name: redundant-harness-folders
goal: Remove redundant component namespaces, preserve helper placement, identities, routes and rendered behavior, and reject reintroduction

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The existing component-category migration inserted a product namespace beneath explorer-ui and retained 84 internal forwarding files. Flatten 85 implementations; keep public route directories and registered IDs.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing registry/category checks required explorer-ui grouping and visual scenarios but allowed nested product-name directories. Extend the standard visual registry guard; pre-relocate test imports before freezing its genuine source-policy failure. Extend existing migration guard to retain original moves with explicit reviewed follow-up locations.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable failing guard preserved in /tmp/harness-folders-final-red.json; the standard visual registry assertion reports the actual redundant source directories before relocation.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Move 85 implementations directly under explorer-ui, remove 84 internal forwarding files, rewrite exact import/source addresses, retain stable registered IDs and public routes, and add reviewed helper follow-up locations without overwriting original moves.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Flattened 85 implementations, removed 84 internal forwarding files, updated imports/ownership and 41 reviewed helper follow-up paths. Latest-main test-only red 410b13321b3fceafd20fe6063402383b0e0f32cdf54746b342e1aed8fa3b375e fails on actual unflattened a889c71; 32 focused guards pass. Source parity confirms all 85 definitions unchanged apart from path relocation and current main navbar order. Reports audit clear after restoring original formatting.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
